remarks: 17 Seabreeze Pl "Windswept" is a rare waterfront offering. A thoughtfully designed coastal retreat where architecture and setting come together to create this prized home. The steel-framed construction offers just over 2,000 sq ft across three finished levels. Designed to maximize natural light and panoramic water views, the home features a dramatic 16-foot wall of glass visible from the living room, office, and primary suite. A custom pivot entry door creates a striking first impression, leading into an open living and subtle nautical-inspired elements, defined by coastal aesthetic metal railings throughout.The flexible floor plan includes a main-level bedroom with access to a full bath. The second floor offers a primary suite with en-suite bath, private balcony, and a custom sliding wall system allowing for privacy or expanded sightlines. The third floor, accessed via a floating staircase, features a vaulted ceiling making the room airy and spacious with a full bath, and private deck with expansive water views, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Exterior upgrades include new composite siding, awning, and professionally designed landscaping with drip irrigation. Owned solar panels help offset rising electricity costs. Enjoy nearby Baxter Park, a city-maintained, dog-friendly waterfront park with seating, small kyak launch, a cherished amenity of the Harbor Shores community
